## Meeting Purpose

[Discuss requirements and pain points for a new canteen meal ordering system for construction workers.](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=0.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [Main goal: Pre-ordering system to reduce food waste and improve meal planning](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=6.0)
  - [Multiple canteens serving diverse workforce (Muslim, Indian, Portuguese workers)](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=148.0)
  - [Need simple, intuitive interface for workers with varying tech literacy](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=851.0)
  - [Phased approach: Start with core pre-ordering, then add features like cook displays](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=539.0)

## Topics

### Current Meal System Challenges

  - [No ordering process; cooks prepare estimated quantities](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=100.0)
  - [Food waste due to over-preparation (250 meals cooked for \~200 needed)](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=301.0)
  - [Dietary restrictions not always accommodated (e.g. halal, vegetarian)](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=150.0)
  - [Difficulty tracking meals across multiple companies/canteens](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=360.0)

### New System Requirements

  - [Pre-ordering by Saturday for following week's lunches/dinners](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=282.0)
  - [3-week rotating menu (changeable 3-4 times/year by admins)](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=219.0)
  - [Bilingual interface (English/Portuguese)](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=895.0)
  - [QR code or ID number for worker identification](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=934.0)
  - [Ability to reassign workers between canteens](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=499.0)
  - [Admin features to manage non-compliant workers](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=262.0)

### User Interface Considerations

  - [Extremely simple, touch-based interface for low-tech literacy](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=851.0)
  - [Tablet kiosks at canteens for those without smartphones](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=915.0)
  - [Favorite meals feature for quicker re-ordering](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=1831.0)
  - [Dietary restriction profiles to filter incompatible meals](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=1901.0)

### Implementation Approach

  - [Target September for initial rollout after summer slowdown](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=1320.0)
  - [Start with one canteen, then expand after resolving issues](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=1368.0)
  - [Admin-managed initially, gradually shift responsibilities to workers](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=1064.0)
  - [Potential for expansion to other markets (e.g. Germany) in future](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=2136.0)

## Next Steps

  - [Develop proposal for MVP (Minimum Viable Product) focused on core pre-ordering](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=2220.0)
  - [Create visual prototype/demo for June 6th canteen opening if possible](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=1190.0)
  - [Plan phased feature rollout (core ordering first, then additional features)](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=2220.0)
  - [Consider on-site visit to observe workflow once system is operational](https://fathom.video/share/TbSiUm42sYKuNTE-sVeynPk8nUvs9yHy?tab=summary&timestamp=2394.0)
